comments_text: Sequence analysis:APD analysis reveals that the sequence of THE PEPTIDE shows 58.8% similarity to Lasioglossin LL-II. molecular formula:C81H143N20O19S1; M.W. 1758.191; GRAVY: -0.053; The Wimley-White whole-residue hydrophobicity: 1.95 kcal/mol; molar extinction coefficient: 5550. Structure: Helical in 8mM SDS or 40% TFE. Activity: Active against S. mutans, S. enterica, and S. aureus (MIC 50 uM), and C. albicans, C. grabrata (MIC 50 uM), and C. neoformans (MIC 0.5 uM). Toxicity: Weak hemolysis 6.6% at 50 uM (20% at 100 uM). More hemolytic than MP-L, MP-B and MP-X.
